question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank refers to a force that compels someone to act.
 
• The sentence talks about necessity driving actions and causing unrest.
 
• **"Irresistible"** means impossible to resist or control. In this context, it portrays necessity as a powerful force that compels action. (अप्रतिरोध्य)
 
• Hence, The correct blank is** 'Irresistible.'**

Therefore, The correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

Correct sentence:__ Necessity is an (1)** __irresistible__** force that compels a man to do things. It stirs the mind so (2) ________ that it causes great unrest that continues until the necessity is (3) ________. As order comes out of (4) ________ chaos so does an invention out of some (5) ________. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Essential" **suggests something is necessary but not necessarily forceful. (आवश्यक)
 
• **"Unpredictable"** doesn't convey the idea of compulsion. (अप्रत्याशित)
 
• **"Inconceivable" **means difficult to imagine, which doesn't fit the context of a driving force. (समझ से बाहर)
